'''Sclavos''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Kowak/Legends|Kowak]], located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Sevetta sector/Legends|Sevetta sector]]. The city was founded and developed in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] by [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Sono Molec/Legends|Sono Molec]] of the [[Zygerrian Slave Empire/Legends|Zygerrian Slave Empire]]. Originating as a [[Slaver/Legends|slavers']] outpost, Sclavos expanded over [[Time/Legends|time]] into the seat of the [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] prince's power, eventually leading to the city becoming Kowak's ''de facto'' [[Capital/Legends|capital]]. Molec and his subjects saw Kowak transformed into a [[Satellite/Legends|satellite]] headquarters for the [[Zygerrian Slavers Guild]], and Sclavos—along with Kowak's other newly established settlements, [[Lanturi]] and [[Caden]]—became a place for local slavers to [[Fuel/Legends|refuel]], resupply, and trade in slaves from a variety of sources.

==Description==
[[File:RodianFreeingEnslaved.png|thumb|left|200px|A slave den on the outskirts of Sclavos]]
Sclavos was the ''de facto'' [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kowak/Legends|Kowak]], a [[Forest/Legends|rainforest]]-covered world in the [[Sevetta sector/Legends|Sevetta sector]], located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The city was positioned atop a rhombus-shaped plateau of [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Granite/Legends|granite]], one that spanned several [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] in width. Three of the plateau's sides were cliffs that rose thirty [[Meter/Legends|meters]] above steep embankments covered in dense vegetation, while the fourth was a gradual slop of rocky outcroppings that descended into the surrounding [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]].<ref name="FLT" />

The city's lower landings comprised Sclavos' [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] sector, where dozens of huts and makeshift villages were occupied by a variety of beings from across known space, forced into bondage and awaiting purchase. The area was surrounded by tall wire fences, with each domicile connected by a narrow dirt road, and enclosed by a smooth granite wall that served to keep the slaves in and the jungle predators out. An overhead look of Sclavos revealed a patchwork of buildings with [[Bronzium/Legends|bronzium]], [[Gold/Legends|golden]], and patinated rooftops, in addition to numerous rooftop landing platforms spread throughout the southern portion of the city. Sclavos' streets played host to thousands of [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]], [[Thief/Legends|thieves]], [[Slaver/Legends|slavers]], and prospective buyers, who all flocked to the city's crowded marketplace, full of [[Tent/Legends|tents]] and shops displaying caged slaves. The plateau's northern peninsula was overwhelmingly dominated by the [[Molec Royal Palace/Legends|Molec Royal Palace]], an enormous [[Jade/Legends|jade]]-colored ziggurat that towered over the rest of Sclavos.<ref name="FLT" />

==Behind the scenes==
The city of Sclavos was first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe in the [[roleplaying game]] adventure book ''[[Friends Like These]]'', published on [[December 8]], [[2016]] by [[Fantasy Flight Games]].

Sclavos likely derives its name from the [[Wikipedia:Spanish language|Spanish]] word "''esclavos''," meaning "slaves."
